title: Dave Frank, sheet music and the banana song
summary: Dave Frank's sheet music department and writing I Like Bananas Because They Have No Booze.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: You're gonna have to dig all those things up. We can talk again. Anyway, what did Dave have then? He had piano rolls and what else?
Piano rolls and piano sheet music.
Did he have the records then in those days?

No. Somebody else, if I remember correctly, someone else had that department. And then Dave took it over. I just don't quite remember. Because I was in a different department. But I knew that Dave had the sheet music. Dave's still living. Yes. Ted's mother, Mariam, died just recently.

Dave is supposed to be in bad shape, I heard. No, he's not either. Ted says he's in fine shape. He's 95 years old. Great. He's a man that I wanted to write a book, you know. I sent him a whole list of questions and everything. Hoping that it would spark his memory when he was down in Florida.
You know this tune, I Like Bananas Because They Have No Booze? Oh yeah. That we made a recording with Sharky? It's a wonderful... Dave Frank wrote that. He wrote the words? Oh yeah.
Did he write the music or do you know?
I don't know. But Ted gave me a copy of it. Oh great. Not long ago.
